name: Optasia Limited
summary: Optasia Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides analytics technology and fintech services in Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. The company offers micro financing solutions, including micro and nano lending, AI-led credit scoring, credit decisioning, full loan lifecycle management, and financial inclusion services for individuals and small businesses. It also provides airtime credit solutions, including airtime advances, data advances, package credit services, and omnichannel credit delivery solutions for mobile network operators.
